mapper.select:
SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.STDVALUE, B.CONCENTUNITNAME, B.UNCERTAINTY, B.UNCERTAINTYPERCENT, E.LOGTYPE, E.VENDORID, E.PRICE, F.MTLNAME, F.SPECIFICATION, F.MTLCATEGORYID, G.MTLCATEGORYNAME, F.ORGID AS MTLORGID, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = '1' THEN '废弃' WHEN A.STOCKQTY > 0 THEN '正常' ELSE '无库存' END AS STOCKSTATUS FROM T_EMC_STOCK A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STOCKID, STDVALUE, CONCENTUNITNAME, UNCERTAINTY, UNCERTAINTYPERCENT FROM T_EMC_STOCK_CONCENT M WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_STOCK_CONCENT N WHERE M.STOCKID = N.STOCKID AND N.ID < M.ID) ) B ON A.ID = B.STOCKID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT VENDORID, PRICE, STOCKID, LOGTYPE FROM T_EMC_STOCK_LOG C WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T_EMC_STOCK_LOG D WHERE C.STOCKID = D.STOCKID AND D.ID < C.ID) ) E ON A.ID = E.STOCKID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL F ON A.MTLID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL_CATEGORY G ON F.MTLCATEGORYID = G.ID) T
AND T.MTLCATEGORYNAME in ('标准样品','一般试剂')
AND T.STOCKQTY <= T.LOWLIMIT
AND T.STATUS = '0' AND T.STOCKQTY >0 AND T.REMINDDAYS IS NOT NULL AND T.EXPIREDATE IS NOT NULL AND ( T.EXPIREDATE - SYSDATE) <= T.REMINDDAYS
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
SELECT T.* FROM T_EMC_STOCK T WHERE T.EXPIREDATE <= SYSDATE

SELECT T.MTLID FROM( SELECT T.*,B.MANAGEMENTTYPE FROM T_EMC_STOCK T LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL A ON T.MTLID = A.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MTL_CATEGORY B ON A.MTLCATEGORYID = B.ID WHERE T.STOCKQTY <= T.LOWLIMIT)T
GROUP BY T.MTLID
